name: Design assumption change register
summary: When client criteria or design assumptions change, the project engineer gets one sourced register: what changed, which recorded requirements it touches, how firm each source is, and what still needs confirmation. No design basis is altered.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own design, written from its published map of how design criteria change on an engineering project: the recorded requirements, the client instructions and workshop notes, and the prior register, each with set column headers; every statement graded by how firm its source is; every conflict shown rather than settled; and the technical basis and the changed requirement confirmed by different people.
